newsitem.title: FRANCE: French flown airfreight traffic up 1.5pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: French flown airfreight traffic up 1.5pct in 96.

text.p: French airports handled some 1.27 million tonnes of flown airfreight in 1996, up 1.5 percent on 1995, figures issued by France's airports authority federation, UCCEGA, show.

"Contrary to previous years, the growth in traffic tabled by Paris/CDG and Paris/Orly airports in 1996 was significantly below that of the regional airports where the growth rate on 1995 was 4.2 percent," UCCEGA said in a statement.
The Paris airports accounted for 87.7 percent of global flown airfreight handled at French airports in 1996 compared to 88.4 percent in 1995, the figures show.
Topping an air cargo table of around 60 regional airports was Basle-Mulhouse which had achieved growth in traffic of 28.2 percent in 1996 and 13.8 percent over the period 1992-1996, UCCEGA added.
